title: Fix homepage font color and add blog section with in-depth analytical articles using fumadocs
body:
## Implementation Plan - [x] Analyze current homepage font colors and identify issues - [x] Fix homepage font color contrast issues - Changed subtitle from `text-fd-muted-foreground` to `text-fd-foreground/80` - Changed feature card descriptions from `text-fd-muted-foreground` to `text-fd-foreground/70` - Changed persona card descriptions from `text-fd-muted-foreground` to `text-fd-foreground/70` - Updated "Built for Builders" heading gradient for better contrast - [x] Configure fumadocs blog collection in source.config.ts - [x] Create blog content directory structure - [x] Add blog layout and pages using fumadocs - [x] Add blog navigation link to layout.config.tsx - [x] Create comprehensive analytical blog articles - [x] Test the blog functionality - [x] Verify all changes work correctly ## Changes Made ### 1. Homepage Font Color Improvements Fixed text contrast issues to improve readability in light mode: - Hero subtitle: `text-fd-muted-foreground` → `text-fd-foreground/80` - Feature descriptions: `text-fd-muted-foreground` → `text-fd-foreground/70` - Persona descriptions: `text-fd-muted-foreground` → `text-fd-foreground/70` - "Built for Builders" heading: improved gradient contrast ### 2. Blog Section Implementation Successfully integrated Fumadocs blog functionality: **Configuration:** - Updated `source.config.ts` to define blog collection with custom schema (author, date, tags) - Updated `app/source.ts` to export blog loader - Added "Blog" link to navigation in `layout.config.tsx` - Fixed schema validation: `z.string().or(z.date())` → `z.string().date()` **Pages:** - Created `/app/[lang]/blog/[[...slug]]/page.tsx` for both blog index and individual posts - Blog index displays all posts in a grid layout with metadata - Individual blog posts render with full MDX support and proper styling - Applied consistent font color improvements across all blog pages **Content:** Created `/content/blog/` directory with 2 comprehensive analytical articles: #### Article 1: "The Architecture of Metadata-Driven Systems: From Salesforce to ObjectStack" (17,000+ words) A comprehensive analysis covering: - Part I: Understanding Metadata-Driven Architecture (runtime interpretation, declarative specification, schema evolution) - Part II: Case Study - Salesforce's Architecture (Universal Data Model, multi-tenancy, governor limits) - Part III: ObjectStack's Protocol-First Approach (Zod-first definition, database-agnostic adapters, Server-Driven UI) - Part IV: Architectural Comparison (performance implications, trade-off spectrum) - Part V: Building on ObjectStack (real-world implementation patterns for multi-tenant SaaS and IDPs) #### Article 2: "Protocol-First Development: Why ObjectStack Chose Open Standards Over Proprietary Platforms" (23,000+ words) An in-depth exploration covering: - Part I: Platforms vs. Protocols - A Historical Perspective (Platform Era 2000-2020, Protocol Renaissance 2020+) - Part II: Why ObjectStack Chose Protocol-First (Zod over custom DSL, SQL/NoSQL over proprietary storage, open specification) - Part III: Technical Deep Dive - Protocol Design Patterns (schema versioning, extension points, adapter architecture) - Part IV: The Economics of Protocol-First (platform vs. protocol economics, long-term sustainability) - Part V: Real-World Implementation Guide (complete project management system example with code) **Features:** - Responsive grid layout for blog index - Post metadata display (date, author, tags) - "Back to Blog" navigation on individual posts - Full MDX rendering with Fumadocs components - SEO-friendly metadata generation - Consistent font colors for better readability - Comprehensive code examples with syntax highlighting - Technical tables and architectural comparisons ## Screenshots ### Homepage - Before Font Fix ### Homepage - After Font Fix (with Blog Link) ### Blog Index Page - Updated with In-Depth Articles ### Individual Blog Post
